title: Brand-new account: find someone on campus to hang out with this week
goal: You just heard about this app and want someone on campus to hang out with this week. Make an account with your school e-mail, then use the app to find a person or plan you could join this week and tell them you're in.

setup.notes: Fresh account: sample profiles are shown only to demo accounts, so a new real user sees what a real first-week student sees (cold start).

success.description: Signed up AND joined/requested a plan or sent a friend request / message to someone.
